messages:
Elaine: heads-up — we need a short sync on acceptance criteria for the upcoming GA. focus: contracts, pricing guardrails, and an escape-hatch for customers who hit regressions. TL;DR of ask: can legal/finance sign off on a minimal T&Cs addendum? and ops: do we have a documented rollback/feature-flag plan?
Mike: +1. I can take legal/finance handoff. what exactly do you want in the addendum? simple SLA window + credit calc?
Elaine: yes, minimal. propose: 99.9% regional uptime baseline, credit = pro rata monthly refund capped at 50% of monthly invoice. also require data residency clause opt-in for Private.
Sarah: for pricing guardrails we should add a burst-protection clause and a clear throttling policy in the docs. customers need deterministic costs and a path to Dedicated/Private.
Jon: agree on throttling. suggest we include a sample contract clause and a config snippet customers can paste:
Jon: ```
# example: billing/escape hatch
route: /v1/generate
quota_policy: "burst_limit=2000/min, soft_limit=1500/min, fallback_model=small-quant"
```
Lily: docs note: add an "If things go wrong" section with escalation matrix (support tiers, SLOs, contact emails, target MTTR). also add clear instructions for rolling back a canary and for switching to fallback model.
Elaine: support SLOs we want: page 1: incident ack < 15m for P0, investigation start < 1h, RCA within 72h. are those realistic for GA?
Mike: ops and SRE can we commit? ops: we'll aim for ack < 15m for GA customers on paid tiers, 30m for self-serve. RCA SLA is fine but need capacity for followups.
Sarah: pricing readiness: need a public pricing page draft + interstitial in Console explaining Dedicated commitment discounts. marketing to review copy by EOD Thurs.
Jon: tech constraints: autoscaling warmup can be 90s at ~large seq lengths, so our escape-hatch must include immediate fallback to smaller model + prefix caching. Add that to runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy notice: canary rollout started to us-west-2 at 2024-10-05T14:02Z (build 7a9c). watch for latency regressions.
Lily: runbook snippet for rollback: 1) disable canary route 2) enable fallback_model in routing policy 3) notify oncall + customers list if any. I'll draft the snippet.
Elaine: outstanding actions: Mike -> legal/finance clause draft (due +72h); Sarah -> pricing page draft (due +48h); Lily -> runbook + rollback snippet (due +24h); Jon -> routing/fallback config example and perf note (due +48h). I'll assemble a GA acceptance checklist after these land.
Mike: noted. I'll ping finance and get an initial clause today.
Jon: I'll prepare routing examples and a quick perf note.
Sarah: will seed the pricing draft and loop marketing.
Lily: drafting runbook now, will post in this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
Elaine: thanks all. we'll reconvene Thurs standup if anything blocks. tagging SRE and Legal if they want to jump in. :thumbsup:
